title: Labor OS and Typed Jobs
subtitle: The execution layer should convert plans into typed jobs managed by a governed labor operating system.

display.problem: Intelligence must become typed work with lifecycle, permissions, artifacts, logs, and approvals.
display.insufficient: Chat outputs do not provide deterministic job lifecycle, tool isolation, auditability, or repeatable cognitive manufacturing.
